messages:
irene: quick heads-up — proposing RBAC tighten for private deploys: remove cluster-admin from 'deployer' and add a dedicated keystore-decrypt role for onprem agents. need sec+ops sign-off before rolling.
sam: paste the minimal role change so i can validate token scopes and audit fields.
irene: pasted the snippet i validated in a sandbox:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: keystore-decrypt
rules:
  - apiGroups: [\"kms.redwood.io\"]
    resources: [\"decryptrequests\"]
    verbs: [\"create\"]
```
leo: two checks: (1) ensure API server audit policy includes request.user and response.status for kms.redwood.io decryptrequests, (2) onprem keystore agent currently logs locally — we should ship logs to SIEM over TLS before we remove broad creds.
mira: netpol concern — keystore agent must only talk to HSM/eproxy at 10.8.0.5:443 and metrics endpoint 127.0.0.1:9100. If netpols are too aggressive we risk failing decrypts and app-level fail-open scenarios.
irene: rollout plan: canary in eu-onprem, 24h observation window for decrypt latency, success rate, and audit entries. rollback path: re-add deployer cluster-admin and revert netpols if decrypt error rate spikes.
sam: CVE context? we had a CVE flagged for the agent recently — is it patched in the package we'll deploy?
leo: triage: CVE-2026-1421 impacts agent < 1.3.2. patched in 1.3.3; we also pushed a mitigation to 1.3.2 backports in private channels. recommend upgrading canary hosts to 1.3.3 and running smoke decrypt tests first.
kms-bot: KMS audit forwarding: enabled for eu-onprem. Destination: siem-internal.redwood.local:6514 (TLS). Last verification: 2026-03-10. No dropped events in last 72h.
mira: add automated alert: decrypt_fail_rate > 0.5% for 5m during canary -> suspend rollout and notify #eng-oncall.
oncall-bot: alert created: onprem.keystore.decrypt_fail_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> pager to #eng-oncall. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onprem-keystore-failures
sam: audit retention question — compliance requires 1 year for some customers. what's our retention on eu-onprem KMS indexes?
leo: current eu-onprem KMS audit retention: 13 months. We have a retention-extension workflow for exceptions; log access requests must include customer justification and DRI approval.
irene: i'll open a PR with the RBAC role + netpol and tag sec/ops. plan to start canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. tagging @sam @leo @mira for approvals. :thumbsup:
sam: approving, will run smoke tests during canary window and validate token scopes.
leo: approving from sec side; leaving a note to reference CVE fix and test vector in the PR.
mira: approving for netpols, will coordinate with net-infra for conntrack tuning and TLS session keepalives if we see spikes.
irene: thanks all — PR link will follow. i'll include explicit rollback commands and a checklist: upgrade agent -> enable SIEM logship -> apply role -> apply netpol -> run smoke decrypts -> monitor alerts.
